leads.name: Kopfulme in der Beerlage
leads.note: A pollarded white elm, completely hollow with an opening you can stand in, 5.34 m round at 1.30 m and 12.4 m tall, planted around 1650 (plus or minus 70 years), Naturdenkmal since 2014, publicly accessible. Baumkunde register 3375. Named on 2026-10-02 by Wolfgang Schurmann, moderator of that register, as his favourite tree, in reply to Hidde's mail; he visits it often. Beerlage is a Bauerschaft of Billerbeck, Kreis Coesfeld, about 5 km from Billerbeck station (RB63 from Munster, 30 min), so not inside Munster's day-trip boundary. Billerbeck has no page; the four-tree floor is paused for new places (2026-10-01), so this waits for three more Billerbeck or Coesfeld trees, or for the pause to lift.

leads.name: Antoniusbaum in Goxel
leads.note: Naturdenkmal, 5.22 m girth (2020), 16 m, planted 1811 at a Bildstock of St Anthony after the Napoleonic invasion (second tree died); OSM tree node at 51.92952 7.10866 (confirmed pin). Stands 'mitten im Feld' with the nearest mapped way a grade3 track 250 m west; no foot access found, so access not stated honestly. Goxel is Coesfeld, ~15 km from Billerbeck. Deliver if a field path to it is found.

leads.name: Silber-Weide bei Laer (Flooth)
leads.note: Hollow, 6.4 m girth (2024), 15 m, 200 yr, on a public Wirtschaftsweg at the Neben Aa east of Laer, register visit 30.01.2026; 52.0669 7.3882 per register (52 03.6693 N, 7 23.8821 E). Unremarkable for the walk, no OSM check made; spare.

leads.name: Efeu als Baum bei Billerbeck (L581)
leads.note: Ivy-clad host tree 25 m high on the L581 towards Havixbeck, public roadside, 51.97212 7.32474, register visit 2019 only. Host tree and ivy not separately dated; not a collectible trunk, not delivered.

leads.name: Eibe bei Burg Huelshoff (Havixbeck)
leads.note: 4.8 m girth (2014), ~300 years, possibly fused multi-stem, row of 8 older yews in the winter boskett at Wasserburg Huelshoff; register: 'Privatgelaende geduldet, Zutrittszeiten beachten'; park/museum with opening hours and entry. Access and which yew not settled this pass; 51.97081 7.50447.

leads.name: Kreuzwegbuchen bei Stevede
leads.note: Oddly shaped beeches along the Steveder Kreuzweg, ~220 m wood path, public; ~3 m girth, planted 1880; ensemble not a single point, 51.91221 7.09173, ~15 km away. Spare.

leads.name: Linde bei Schloss Westerwinkel (Herbern)
leads.note: 9.2 m girth, 600 yr, 17 m; register says public but it is a private castle estate; ~30 km, outside range.
